programme.title: Krew Vlogs
programme.desc: Experience the highs and lows of the wild as KREW takes on their first-ever camping trip. From battling swarms of mosquitoes and struggling to set up a lopsided tent to cooking "unesthetic" breakfast beans and campfire sausages, this vlog captures it all. Watch the fun unfold as they navigate the realities of survival, share laughs, and ultimately learn that camping isn't always like the movies.

programme.title: Krew Vlogs
programme.desc: Experience Singapore with KREW as they visit the Jewel at Changi Airport to see the world's tallest indoor waterfall. From a daring 10-minute airport haircut challenge to taste-testing 7-Eleven dim sum and "serious" popcorn, the fun never stops. Watch them explore the Sensory Odyssey exhibit, create digital sea creatures, and brave a nearly empty Halloween Horror Nights at Universal Studios.

programme.title: Krew Vlogs
programme.desc: Experience the magic of KREW’s winter adventures! From building a "Diva Snowman" in the freezing cold to braving the heights of the Capilano Suspension Bridge at night, this episode is packed with holiday cheer. Watch the gang take on a chaotic gingerbread build-off, explore a festive Christmas Market via sea bus, and exchange hilarious secret Santa gifts. A perfect KREWmas celebration!

programme.title: Krew Vlogs
programme.desc: KREW sets sail for an unforgettable fishing adventure! After stocking up on gourmet ingredients, the crew hits the ocean to catch their own dinner. Watch as they battle the waves, reel in rockfish and flounder, and haul in a massive catch of crabs. The excitement continues back in the kitchen as they try to cook their fresh bounty. Will their culinary skills match their fishing luck?

programme.title: Krew Vlogs
programme.desc: Experience the ultimate adventure as the KREW travels to Macau! From tasting the #1 bestselling jerky and fluffy mango mochi to exploring the historic Ruins of St. Paul's, the group dives deep into local culture. Watch their first-ever meet and greet in Asia, an emotional fan mail unboxing, and a fun martial arts challenge. Of course, no trip is complete without trying world-famous egg tarts!

programme.title: Krew Vlogs
programme.desc: Travel with KREW to Bana Hills, a stunning amusement park in the sky! Watch as they brave the world's longest cable car ride, attempt a spinning dropper, and navigate a tricky maze garden. Between reapplying sunscreen and laughing through carnival games, the crew explores medieval sights and the iconic Golden Bridge. Experience the heights and hilarious moments of their high-altitude adventure!

programme.title: Krew Vlogs
programme.desc: Experience a Wild West adventure with KREW in Canmore, Alberta! Watch as they explore a historic mountain town, go horseback riding through scenic trails, and compete in a sharpshooter challenge. From tasting real maple syrup on snow to trying weird deep-fried carnival treats, this vlog is packed with fun. Will they find gold or just "fool's gold"? Find out in this action-packed western journey!

programme.title: The MeatEater Podcast
programme.desc: Steven Rinella talks with Caleb Hubbard of the Hubbard Urban Entymology Lab at New Mexico State University and "Bubbly" Doug Duren. Topics discussed: Stay tuned for twice a week MeatEater Podcast drops starting in March; come to the Safari Club International 2026 Convention on Feb. 19th to see Steve and Morgan Potter; a correction on Colorado wolf recovery; sous vide rewarming for frostbite; the ins and outs of the New World screw worm; how all warm blooded critters are potential hosts; being eaten alive; Doug's Sharing the Land organization; and more. The New World Screwworm Threat Survey: https://acesnmsu.az1.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_eLjo05717Wzz1em The New World Screwworm is a serious pest threat to livestock and wildlife, and New Mexico is taking steps to stay proactive-not reactive. The survey gathers input from ranchers, producers, hunters, land stewards, and community members across New Mexico. We're studying what people know, believe, and need regarding screwworm prevention and response.

programme.title: The MeatEater Podcast
programme.desc: Steven Rinella and the MeatEater crew discuss: Steve's new baby mouse; Corner Crossing updates; the endangered jaguar hanging out in Arizona; live sonar for billfish and the end of integrity in fishing; Louisiana's National Forest land transfer; the first ever detection of CWD in Wyoming's largest elk herd; South Dakota sets an unprecedented elk hunting management plan; Michigan's major buck hunting rule changes; and more.

programme.title: The MeatEater Podcast
programme.desc: Steven Rinella talks with New Mexico Senator Martin Heinrich, Ryan Callaghan, and Randall Williams. Topics discussed: Corner crossing and the Supreme Court ruling; stream access; the Arctic National Wildlife Refuge, mining, and caribou; the Roadless Rule; where to develop and not develop renewables; relative bipartisan support for nuclear energy; reintroducing pronghorn back to an area of New Mexico; the breadth of the coalition that came together around keeping public lands in public hands; and more.

programme.title: The MeatEater Podcast
programme.desc: Steven Rinella talks with naturalist, writer, and sculptor George Bumann, Brody Henderson, Phil Taylore, and Corinne Schneider. Topics discussed: George's book, Eavesdropping On Animals; Animal vocalizations; subscribe to the new Bear Grease YouTube channel; laws on game retrieval; just how pungent skunk odor really is; stay tuned for MeatEater TV's new "12 in 26" hunt series, starting with Jani's Manitoba bear episode; how absurd it is that guys called better than turkeys themselves; what various raven calls mean; how the birds gossip about everything; wolf howling and squirrel chirping translations; all the animals are talking about and know you; silence as the most important alarm that exists; The Yellowstone Summit; and more. Order George's book EAVESDROPPING ON ANIMALS here: https://www.georgebumann.com/gb/eavesdropping-on-animals/ Register for The Yellowstone Summit here: https://www.yellowstonesummit.com/

programme.title: The MeatEater Podcast
programme.desc: Steven Rinella talks with author Craig Fehrman. Topics discussed: Craig's new book, This Vast Enterprise: A New History of Lewis & Clark; York, Ordway, Black Buffalo, Sacajawea, and other key players on the expedition; Sacajawea's sense of humor; diplomacy and discovery; medical care; views of slavery and Lewis and Clark's different views on it; the abundance of species; and more.

Expect to learn the real story of what happened to Jeremy during the snowplow accident, what it feels like to get run over and see your eyeball fall out of it’s socket, how Jeremy was able to recover so well and look as just as he did before the accident, how to deal with excruciating amount of pain, how Jeremy’s meditation practices came in handy during his darkest hours, what it was like being a part of The Avengers & the craziness of being one of the biggest stars in the world, and much more…

programme.title: Modern Wisdom
programme.desc: Alex’s Twitter has been one of my favourite sources of insights over the last few years. Today we get to go through some of his best lessons about life, human behaviour, psychology, business and resilience again. And as always this is so, so good. Expect to learn the skills needed to thrive in todays every changing world, why a few bad days shouldn’t ruin the rest of your year, how Alex’s mind has changed about work and happiness in the past year, how to figure out what you want in life, the rare dynamic between Alex and his wife Leila, why having a work life balance isn’t all it’s cracked up to be, why more money won’t buy you more happiness, how to get a top tier girls and much more…

programme.title: Modern Wisdom
programme.desc: Jimmy Carr is known for brutal roasts, but this conversation reveals a more introspective side. programme.title: Runaway Country with Alex Wagner
programme.desc: As the electoral landscape is turning blue, Donald Trump is seeing red. To sooth his wounded ego, the White House is running pro-Trump ads during NFL games, illegally rescinding hundreds of millions of dollars from federal agencies, and threatening the Kennedy Performing Arts Center with demolition for not adding Trump’s name to the facade. To understand the cost of the president's flailing narcissism, Alex chats with Leonard Slatkin, the former conductor of the National Symphony Orchestra—now on involuntary tour since the Kennedy Center's closure. Then, she is joined by historian and On Tyranny author, Timothy Snyder, to discuss what else we can expect from this late stage autocrat.

programme.title: Hysteria
programme.desc: Erin and KQED’s Marisa Lagos take a look at the democrats’' national polling surge, analyze the heck is going on in California politics, and look into the horrific yet familiar Cornell 7 sexual assault case. Then labor economist Kathryn Anne Edwards joins to demystify everything from the job market to the AI bubble. They wrap up with a petty conversation about the WNBA finals and killer e-bikes.

programme.title: Strict Scrutiny
programme.desc: In the fifth and final installment of our Hot Supreme Court Reform series, Kate speaks with Gabe Roth, executive director of Fix the Court. What would a meaningful and enforceable set of ethics rules look like for the Supreme Court justices? Why isn’t there an Inspector General for the judiciary? How are there no real rules around recusals? Roth makes the case for these nonpartisan reforms and more.

programme.title: Lovett or Leave It
programme.desc: Trump and AI execs pinky swear, Pete Hegseth gets treasonal allergies, and Republicans Make Nixon Great Again. Then Hollywood legend Barry Diller is our Guest of the Week and Jared Goldstein is gay for the algorithm. And the rant wheel lands on myopic “biopic” pronunciations and saying no way to “color way.”

programme.title: What a Day
programme.desc: The Group of Seven wealthy democracies said Friday that they plan to release 100 million barrels of oil and fuel products in the coming weeks — starting with “substantial” amounts of diesel. The announcement comes as Trump’s trade battles and his war in Iran have increased U.S. prices for oil and other goods ahead of next month's midterms. To discuss the latest on the war and what's happening in the Middle East, Jane speaks with Tommy Vietor, co-host of Pod Save America.

programme.title: Offline with Jon Favreau
programme.desc: Erin Brockovich has spent three decades helping communities fight the biggest corporations and cruelest environmental injustices, inspiring an Oscar-winning movie along the way. Her latest cause is also her biggest: AI data centers and their insidious arrival to communities across the country. After scores of people wrote to her about the alarming influx of hyperscale projects, Erin launched Brockovich Data Center Reporting—which received nearly 4,000 submissions in its first month alone. She sits down with Jon to discuss everything she’s learned, what the industry gets wrong about the backlash, and whether there’s a way to build what we need without screwing over the people who have to live with it.

programme.title: What a Day
programme.desc: The Group of Seven wealthy democracies said Friday that they plan to release 100 million barrels of oil and fuel products in the coming weeks — starting with “substantial” amounts of diesel. The announcement comes as Trump’s trade battles and his war in Iran have increased U.S. prices for oil and other goods ahead of next month's midterms. To discuss the latest on the war and what's happening in the Middle East, Jane speaks with Tommy Vietor, co-host of Pod Save America.

programme.title: Pod Save America
programme.desc: Pete Hegseth, in an unconventional speech, announces that beardos, weirdos, and wimps are no longer welcome at the Department of War as his boss officially hit the road to campaign for Senate Republicans — whether they want him to or not. Jon and Dan react to Trump's event with Ken Paxton in Texas, Trump proclaiming his love for data centers in a wide-ranging interview with TIME, and Missouri Senator Eric Schmitt's embarrassing mix-up in a Judiciary Committee hearing with former Special Counsel Jack Smith. Then, Rev. Adam Hamilton, the Democratic nominee for Senate in Kansas, talks to Dan about what it'll take to elect the state's first Democratic senator in nearly 100 years, and why he considers himself both a liberal and a conservative.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fill in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Producer/guitarist Josh Carter—one half of genre-bending duo Phantogram—joins host Joel Madden to talk about why trying too hard can kill the art, his creative/lifelong bond with bandmate Sarah Barthel, and gearing up for a summer tour with Deftones. From upstate New York origins to Brooklyn and now L.A., Josh digs into collaboration culture, beat-making roots, Big Grams with Big Boi, and the hip-hop influences (Beastie Boys, Wu-Tang, Public Enemy) that shaped his sound—plus a little baseball talk (Mets, Dodgers, Orioles).

programme.title: Judas Priest: Epitaph

programme.title: Say Anything: Is A Real Boy 20th Anniversary Tour Live from Los Angeles
programme.desc: Say Anything performs ...Is A Real Boy live at The Wiltern, celebrating the album’s 20th anniversary with a special concert event.

programme.title: Bob Dylan: Shadow Kingdom
programme.desc: Bob Dylan performs early songs in an intimate 2021 concert film, delivering reimagined classics like Forever Young and It’s All Over Now, Baby Blue.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Grammy-winning producer and artist Hit-Boy joins Joel Madden to discuss legacy, therapy, fatherhood, and reclaiming his power after years producing for Jay-Z, Nas, and Travis Scott.

programme.title: Lost Evenings VI: Night 1 – Acoustic Duo with Matt Nasir
programme.desc: The opening night of Lost Evenings VI in Anaheim features an intimate acoustic set from Frank Turner and Matt Nasir. The performance blends heartfelt storytelling with stripped-down versions of fan favorites, including “Be More Kind,” “The Way I Tend to Be,” and a moving duet with KT Tunstall. Turner connects deeply with the audience while revisiting early songs and debuting new arrangements in this special evening of community, humor, and reflection.
